Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscounted atoms and misapplied balancing conventions. They incorrectly stated that option B is unbalanced by counting 4 oxygens on the left (it has 3: 1 from H2O and 2 from CO2), while also treating option D as acceptable due to “implied” coefficients even though, as written, H2 + O2 -> H2O is not balanced. This led to selecting D instead of the correct, already balanced option B.
